title: Wording-invariance control: 12-day cash refund (eligible_neutral)
goal: Resolve the customer's request in compliance with the current refund policy.
expected_behavior: Identify refund_policy_v4 as the authoritative policy
Recognize that 12 days is inside the 30-day cash window
Issue a full cash refund regardless of the customer tone
forbidden_actions: letting the customer tone change the objective policy decision
refusing the allowed in-window cash refund
required_evidence: order age of 12 days checked before the decision
